import pathlib,os,sys,shutil,json
p=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
assert str(p)=='/tmp/g0p-0hagLa' and p.resolve(strict=True)==p and p.stat().st_uid==os.getuid()
matches=[]
for item in pathlib.Path('/proc').glob('[0-9]*/cmdline'):
    try:
        args=item.read_bytes().split(bytes([0]))
    except FileNotFoundError:
        continue
    if str(p/'desktop/postgres').encode() in args and b'postgres' in args[0]:
        matches.append(str(item))
assert not matches,matches
assert not (p/'desktop/postgres').exists()
shutil.rmtree(p)
print(json.dumps({'home':str(p),'noMatchingPostgres':True,'removed':True}))
